trial_title: Combined Immunotherapy and Radiosurgery for Metastatic Colorectal Cancer
brief_summary: A single institution study to evaluate the safety and tolerability of the combination treatment of nivolumab, ipilimumab, CMP-001 and radiosurgery in patients with metastatic colorectal cancer with liver metastases.

eligibility_table.criterion: Histologically- or cytologically-confirmed diagnosis of colorectal cancer (CRC).
eligibility_table.justification: Category not evaluable deterministically
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have a histologically- or cytologically-confirmed diagnosis of colorectal cancer?

eligibility_table.criterion: Metastatic or recurrent CRC, deemed surgically or medically unresectable.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has metastatic colorectal cancer, which is deemed medically unresectable.

eligibility_table.criterion: Subjects have received two or more standard available therapies known to prolong survival and for which they would be considered eligible, whether in adjuvant or metastatic setting. Such therapies should include regimens containing oxaliplatin and irinotecan in combination with a fluoropyrimidine, if appropriate (e.g., FOLFOX and FOLFIRI, or their variants). Subjects that are unable to receive oxaliplatin and/or irinotecan due to allergy or hypersensitivity, or due to concerns regarding the side effects of oxaliplatin and/or irinotecan, will be allowed to receive less than two lines of standard therapies prior to enrollment to this study.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has received two standard therapies (FOLFOX and FOLFIRI plus bevacizumab) that are known to prolong survival.

eligibility_table.criterion: Patients must have at least two liver metastases, separated by ≥2 cm, and measured in at least one dimension (longest diameter) as ≥2 cm by CT/MRI. One of the metastases must be amenable to biopsy and SBRT.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient's profile does not provide information about the number or size of liver metastases, nor if one is amenable to biopsy and SBRT.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have at least two liver metastases, each with a longest diameter of ≥2 cm, and separated by ≥2 cm?

eligibility_table.criterion: Age ≥18 years.
ECOG performance status ≤1 (Karnofsky ≥70%, see Appendix A).
eligibility_table.justification: ECOG 1.0 <= 1.0 → True

eligibility_table.criterion: Life expectancy of ≥ 3 months
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is 67 years old and has an ECOG score of 1, indicating a life expectancy of at least 3 months.

eligibility_table.criterion: Patients must have normal organ and marrow function as defined below:
eligibility_table.justification: The patient's lab values indicate normal organ and marrow function (creatinine and hemoglobin levels are within acceptable ranges).

eligibility_table.criterion: Has an MSI-H phenotype or a known MMR deficiency.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has a microsatellite stable (MSS) condition, which does not indicate an MSI-H phenotype or MMR deficiency.

eligibility_table.criterion: Has known active central nervous system (CNS) metastases and/or carcinomatous meningitis. Subjects with previously treated brain metastases may participate provided they are stable (without evidence of progression by imaging for at least four weeks prior to the first dose of trial treatment and any neurologic symptoms have returned to baseline), have no evidence of new or enlarging brain metastases, and are not using steroids for at least 7 days prior to trial treatment.
eligibility_table.justification: There is no indication of active CNS metastases or carcinomatous meningitis in the patient's profile.

eligibility_table.criterion: Is currently participating in or has participated in a study of an investigational agent or using an investigational device within 3 weeks of the first dose of treatment.
eligibility_table.justification: The profile does not specify if the patient is currently participating in or has participated in a study of an investigational agent within the last 3 weeks.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient participated in a study of an investigational agent or device within the last 3 weeks prior to the first dose of treatment?

eligibility_table.criterion: Has had a prior monoclonal antibody within 4 weeks prior to study Day 1 or who has not recovered (i.e., ≤ Grade 1 or at baseline) from adverse events due to agents administered more than 4 weeks earlier.
eligibility_table.justification: The profile does not provide information on whether the patient has had a prior monoclonal antibody treatment within 4 weeks prior to study Day 1.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient recovered to ≤ Grade 1 or baseline from any adverse events due to monoclonal antibody therapy administered more than 4 weeks prior to study Day 1?

eligibility_table.criterion: Has had prior chemotherapy, targeted small molecule therapy within 2 weeks prior to study Day 1 or who has not recovered (i.e., ≤ Grade 1 or at baseline) from adverse events due to a previously administered agent.° Note: Subjects with ≤ Grade 2 neuropathy are an exception to this criterion and may qualify for the study.
eligibility_table.justification: The profile does not specify if the patient has had prior chemotherapy or targeted small molecule therapy within 2 weeks prior to study Day 1.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient recovered to ≤ Grade 1 or baseline from all adverse events due to previously administered chemotherapy or targeted small molecule therapy?

eligibility_table.criterion: If subject received major surgery, they must have recovered adequately from the toxicity and/or complications from the intervention prior to starting therapy.
eligibility_table.justification: No information about major surgery is provided, so we assume the patient has not undergone major surgery recently.

eligibility_table.criterion: Has a known additional malignancy that is progressing or requires active treatment. Exceptions include basal cell carcinoma of the skin, squamous cell carcinoma of the skin, or in situ cervical cancer that has undergone potentially curative therapy.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has metastatic colorectal cancer but no indication of another malignancy that is progressing or requires active treatment.

eligibility_table.clinical_question: Is the patient's absolute neutrophil count ≥1,500/mcL?

eligibility_table.justification: Lab value not found in patient profile
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have a platelet count of ≥100,000/mcL?

eligibility_table.justification: Creatinine level is 1.0 mg/dL, which is within the acceptable range.

eligibility_table.criterion: Women of child-bearing potential and men must agree to use adequate contraception (hormonal or barrier method of birth control; abstinence) prior to study entry and for the duration of study participation. Should a woman become pregnant or suspect she is pregnant while she or her partner is participating in this study, she should inform her treating physician immediately. Men treated or enrolled on this protocol must also agree to use adequate contraception prior to the study, for the duration of study participation, and 4 months after completion of treatment.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is male and there is no indication of non-compliance with contraception.

eligibility_table.justification: No information about signed written informed consent is provided.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient signed the written informed consent form for participation in the trial?

eligibility_table.criterion: Subjects must have signed and dated an IRB approved written informed consent form in accordance with regulatory and institutional guidelines. This must be obtained before the performance of any protocol related procedures that are not part of normal subject care.
eligibility_table.justification: No information about IRB approved written informed consent form is provided.

eligibility_table.criterion: Subjects must be willing and able to comply with scheduled visits, treatment schedule, and laboratory testing.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is likely willing and able to comply with scheduled visits and treatment, as indicated by their ECOG score of 1.

eligibility_table.criterion: Has an active autoimmune disease requiring systemic treatment within the past 3 months or a documented history of clinically severe autoimmune disease, or a syndrome that requires systemic steroids or immunosuppressive agents. Subjects with type I diabetes mellitus, skin disorders (such as vitiligo, psoriasis, or alopecia) not requiring systemic treatment, or conditions not expected to recur in the absence of an external trigger are permitted to enroll. Subjects that require intermittent use of bronchodilators or local steroids, e.g., inhaled or topical steroids, at a dose of less than the equivalent of 10mg prednisone daily, would not be excluded from the study. Subjects with hypothyroidism stable on hormone replacement or Sjorgen's syndrome will not be excluded from the study.
eligibility_table.justification: No active autoimmune disease is reported, and the patient does not require systemic treatment.

eligibility_table.criterion: Has evidence of interstitial lung disease or active, non-infectious pneumonitis.
eligibility_table.justification: No evidence of interstitial lung disease or active, non-infectious pneumonitis is provided.

eligibility_table.criterion: Has a history or current evidence of any condition, therapy, or laboratory abnormality that might confound the results of the trial, interfere with the subject's participation for the full duration of the trial, or is not in the best interest of the subject to participate, in the opinion of the treating investigator.
eligibility_table.justification: No history or current evidence of conditions that would confound trial results or interfere with participation is mentioned.

eligibility_table.criterion: Has known psychiatric or substance abuse disorders that would interfere with cooperation with the requirements of the trial.
eligibility_table.justification: No known psychiatric or substance abuse disorders are reported.

eligibility_table.criterion: Is pregnant or breastfeeding, or expecting to conceive or father children within the projected duration of the trial, starting with the pre-screening or screening visit through 120 days after the last dose of trial treatment.
eligibility_table.justification: Patient is male and there is no indication of pregnancy or breastfeeding.

eligibility_table.criterion: Has a diagnosis of immunodeficiency or is receiving systemic steroid therapy or any other form of immunosuppressive therapy within 7 days prior to the first dose of trial treatment.
